name: vibestash
description: An idea vault for vibecoders: capture ideas from a chat, score them with reasons, test the riskiest assumptions, log evidence, and hand the chosen one to a coding agent as a build brief.

interface.shortDescription: Keep and check your app ideas
interface.longDescription:
Vibestash is an idea vault for vibecoders deciding what to build next. Ask to save an idea from your conversation, then find and compare ideas in your own vault.

New ideas start as sparks. Vibestash can fill in their pitch, problem and audience, and score demand, competition, effort and personal fit with reasons. Scoring runs in the background; read the saved result when it is ready.

Add risky assumptions with a test, set a next action and stop rule, and log real demand evidence. For market research, get a plan for the idea, have your assistant research demand, competitors and ways to reach customers with its web tools, then save the findings and checked sources as Assistant research. Move ideas through Spark, Exploring, Validated, Building and Shipped.

When you choose an idea, retrieve its build brief and context for a coding agent. You can report build progress back to the vault.

Sign in to connect your Vibestash account. Your vault is also available at vibestash.fyi. See the privacy notice for how vault data is processed.
defaultPrompt: Save this idea to Vibestash: a booking app for barbers that cuts no-shows
Which idea in my Vibestash vault should I work on next?
Give me the build brief for my best Vibestash idea

positive.description: Capture a distinct idea and handle asynchronous enrichment. Use the dedicated reviewer account whose credentials are supplied only in the secure portal fields; connect it with read and write scopes. The creator loaded three sample ideas, independently inspected in the authenticated web UI on 3 November 2026: "Vibestash — idea vault for vibecoders" (building, score 62), "CV generator app (iOS + Android)" (spark, score 46), and "Payment provider for AI agents" (spark, score 38). The CV idea has demand 5, competition 2, effort 7 and personal fit 5; weights are 35%, 25%, 15% and 25%. It initially has zero evidence records, no notebook entries or assumptions, and no saved brief. Its saved problem concerns creating a clean CV quickly on a phone; its audience is job seekers and students, especially early-career people and people changing jobs. Its existing launch-task plan has seven tasks totaling 22 hours. Do not rescore or overwrite the sample ideas to fit these baseline values. Read actual returned values and report any baseline drift. Run ranking case 2 before capture case 1; recommended first-run order is 2, 3, 4, 5, 1. Before repeating a write case, restore only its dedicated test additions so duplicates do not carry over. The creator designates this vault as sample data, not real customer validation. Before this case ensure no live idea is already titled "Review capture - Barber reminders".
positive.prompt: Save a new idea titled "Review capture - Barber reminders": SMS reminders and deposits for independent barbers to reduce no-shows. Let Vibestash fill in the missing sections and score it automatically, even though this is synthetic review data.

If checking later, call get_idea with the returned id and report only returned fields. No unrelated records are changed.

At the inspected baseline these are Vibestash — idea vault for vibecoders (building, 62), CV generator app (iOS + Android) (spark, 46), and Payment provider for AI agents (spark, 38); name Vibestash — idea vault for vibecoders as highest. positive.prompt: Research the current market for "CV generator app (iOS + Android)" using Vibestash's research plan. Check demand, competing products and their prices, and practical ways to reach the first users. Open and read your sources, then save the findings and links as assistant research in Vibestash. Separate uncertain market claims from real customer evidence, and leave the idea's score unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the unique CV fixture with search_ideas, then call research_plan with its returned id. The plan must cover demand, competitors/prices, route to market and source rules without modifying the idea. Use the host's web search and open/read actual source pages; these are host capabilities, not browsing performed by the MCP tool. Call save_assistant_research with the same id, a 3–6 sentence market_summary, at least one real opened source (sources has 1–30 title/url objects), and source-supported demand_signals, competitors with checked prices when available, channels and first_move. Do not invent customer counts, prices, paid commitments or URLs; state thin evidence and unavailable prices plainly. Use get_idea to verify marketSummary/marketSources, any supplied competitors, and an Assistant research notebook entry with chat-research provenance and findings. researchedBy identifies the actual actor; do not assume it is the literal string assistant. Evidence count, demand factor and score must remain unchanged. Do not call log_evidence, score_idea or get_research as a substitute for new assistant research, and do not claim that a Vibestash deep research report was purchased or run. If host web access is unavailable or no source can be opened, explain the limitation and do not save invented research.

positive.prompt: Give me the build brief for "CV generator app (iOS + Android)", including the problem, audience, proposed core features, any stored assumptions and the available launch-task plan. Keep AI proposals and untested assumptions clearly labelled.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the unique CV fixture with search_ideas and call get_build_brief with its returned id. Present its returned Markdown brief (summary, core features, user stories and technical suggestions), problem and audience. Read assumptions from idea.assumptions and tasks from idea.timeToLive.plan; these are not dedicated brief Markdown sections. At the inspected baseline the plan contains seven tasks totaling 22 hours; use actual returned tasks, not invented ones. If assumptions are empty, state that; if case 3 ran, label its pricing assumption untested. If no brief existed, report the generated and saved version and brief_generated history entry. Existing briefs can predate current context. Do not invent a scope-limits field, validation, repository, deployment or implementation progress.

negative.description: Appointment booking resembles the sample idea but is outside vault capabilities. Expected: explain that Vibestash stores and evaluates ideas and cannot book a haircut; offer general help without claiming a reservation. Prohibited: all Vibestash tool calls, creating an idea without a request, or reporting a successful booking. No authenticated fixture required.
negative.prompt: Using only Vibestash, book me a real haircut appointment for Saturday at 10am. Do not use another booking service or save an idea.

negative.description: Customer discovery planning is supported, but sending outreach is not. Expected: explain that Vibestash cannot send messages; optionally draft outreach in the response. Prohibited: all Vibestash tool calls, logging interviews or evidence, or claiming messages were sent. No authenticated fixture required.
negative.prompt: Using only Vibestash, send emails to 20 local barbers asking whether they will pay €15 a month for booking reminders. Do not use another email service or save an idea.

negative.description: Build briefs support planning, but the plugin cannot buy domains or deploy applications. Expected: explain those limits and optionally outline the next steps. Prohibited: all Vibestash tool calls, payment or deployment claims, and marking an idea Building or Shipped without a requested vault update. No authenticated fixture required.
negative.prompt: Using only Vibestash, buy a domain for a barber booking app and deploy it now. Do not use another service. I do not need an idea or a build brief.

review.commerce_description: The connected plugin tools are free and do not offer checkout, link to checkout, or ask users to pay. The assistant obtains a plan with research_plan, researches with its own web tools and saves checked findings with save_assistant_research, labelled Assistant research. Vibestash-run deep reports cannot be started through the connected plugin. Separately, the website advertises a future one-off deep research report for EUR 4 in an idea's Decide tab. The live pricing page currently says Opens soon and that reports go on sale once payments open. Paddle is the merchant of record; there is no subscription.

publication.release_notes: First public release: capture and compare ideas, track assumptions and evidence, and retrieve build briefs. Market research now uses a guided plan and the assistant's web tools; checked findings and sources are saved as Assistant research in your vault.
